# `/notification-templates` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### GET /notification-templates/v1

`listNotificationTemplatesV1` — List notification templates

This lists the templates that you have modified for your site.

- Scopes: idn:notification-templates:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `limit` (query) — max 250 — default 250 — Max number of results to return. See [API Standard Collection Parameters](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/standard-collection-parameters) for more information.
  - `offset` (query) — default 0 — Offset into the full result set. Usually specified with *limit* to paginate through the results. See [API Standard Collection…
  - `filters` (query) — fields: key: eq, in, sw; medium: eq, sw; locale: eq, sw — e.g. `medium eq "EMAIL"`
  - `sorters` (query) — fields: key, name, medium — e.g. `key, -name`
- Returns 200: array of templatedto

### POST /notification-templates/v1

`createNotificationTemplateV1` — Create notification template

This will update notification templates that are available in your tenant. Note that you cannot create new templates in your tenant, but you can use this to create custom notifications from existing templates. First, copy the response body from the [get notification template endpoint](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/get-notification-template-v-1) for a template you wish to update and paste it into the request body for this endpoint. Modify the fields you want to change and submit the…

- Scopes: idn:notification-templates:create
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Body (application/json): templatedto
- Returns 200: templatedto

### GET /notification-templates/v1/{id}

`getNotificationTemplateV1` — Get notification template by id

This gets a template that you have modified for your site by Id.

- Scopes: idn:notification-templates:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — Id of the Notification Template
- Returns 200: templatedto

### POST /notification-templates/v1/bulk-delete

`deleteNotificationTemplatesInBulkV1` — Bulk delete notification templates

This lets you bulk delete templates that you previously created for your site.

- Scopes: idn:notification-templates:delete
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Body (application/json): array of templatebulkdeletedto
- Returns 204: no body
